facts.business: Studds Accessories Limited manufactures two-wheeler helmets and boxes, and is one of the world's largest helmet companies by volume.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Upcoming Facility V will take production capacity from 9.5 million to 12.5 million units per annum

key_risks: Helmet penetration in India remains far below global average
Operational, financial and compliance-related risks across business functions
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions are reviewed by the Audit Committee. Prior omnibus approval of the Audit Committee is obtained on periodic basis.
